item.tib: sgra bla'i rgyal mo'i bskul pa
item.coloph: ces pa kho bo dbra btsun g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal bdag rig 'dzin gong ma'i sgrub gnas ma ng+hal ri khrod ge khod bsnyen sgrub kyi skabs su/ shing sbral zla ba 11 tshes 23kyi nub mor yid tsam gnas der mkha' spyod tshogs gral du phyin snang / zhing khams de yi byang shar bswe mkhar nang nas brag mtshan gyi dngos grub tu bab pa/ 'od kyi gang bu thig le sngo mthing ser ljang dmar ba'i rnam pa bcu shar ba'i nang las/ thig le mthing nag zla gam nang ma mo sgra bla'i rgyal mo'i bskyal pa 'di zla 7 tshes 24 kyi nyi shar brda' yig shog ser du phabs pa'o//

item.tib: sgra bla'i rgyal mo'i bskul pa
item.coloph: g.yung drung bon gyi bstan srung ma/ sgra bla'i rgyal mo srog gi spu gri 'di/ li shu stag ring nyid kyi (kyis) bdag zla ba rgyal mtshan blo gros thogs med la brgyud pa yin/ de nas dam nyams lag tu ma shor cig shin tu gnyan la rab tu zab/ u ya/ ag tham/ sa ma yA/ rgya rgya rgya//
